queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `numrows` FROM `ajobmart_orders` `o` LEFT JOIN `ajobmart_users` `u` ON `u`.`id` = `o`.`user_id` LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.order_id, COUNT(oi.id) AS item_lines, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT p.seller_id) AS seller_count FROM ajobmart_order_items oi LEFT JOIN ajobmart_products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT seller_status ORDER BY seller_status SEPARATOR ", ") AS seller_statuses FROM ajobmart_seller_order_fulfillments GROUP BY order_id ) fulfillment_summary ON fulfillment_summary.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT admin_status ORDER BY admin_status SEPARATOR ", ") AS booking_statuses FROM ajobmart_shipping_label_bookings GROUP BY order_id ) booking_summary ON booking_summary.order_id = o.id
